description: Géoportail: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Géoportail. Coverage: Géoportail. The listing groups 15 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Floods Directive - Potential future events (reporting 2019-2022); Floods Directive - Preliminary Flood Risk Assessment - Past Events (re; Annex III Theme Natural Risk Zones - Flood foci; Annex III Theme Natural Risk Zones - Floods Directive - Watercourses w. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
